items.definition:
a device that connects two things
The train cars were joined by a strong coupler.

the quality of being desirable or attractive
The desirability of the new product was high among consumers.

a break or interruption in connection
There was a brief disconnection in the internet service.

a person or company that distills alcoholic beverages
The local distiller produces excellent whiskey.

a person who has enrolled in something
Each enrollee received a welcome packet.

a secondary or alternative plan or resource
Having a fallback plan is always a good idea.

a person who commits fraud
The fraudster was arrested for scamming elderly people.

blunder, social mistake
The politician made a huge gaffe during the live interview.

judge's hammer
The judge struck the gavel to call the court to order.

superficial glamour, showiness
Hollywood is known for its glitz and glamour.

football field; cooking grate
The team practiced on the gridiron every day before the big game.

Scottish dish
Haggis is a traditional Scottish dish often served with neeps and tatties.

ornamental covering for the head
The bride wore an elaborate headdress adorned with pearls.

person who accumulates things excessively
The old woman was a hoarder, and her house was full of junk.

something made at home, especially beer
He proudly offered us a glass of his latest homebrew.

the state of being illegal
The illegality of the action was clear to everyone.

lack of concern for others' feelings
His insensitivity to her feelings caused a lot of pain.

a platform from which rockets are launched
The rocket stood ready on the launchpad.

a style of dance in which participants push or shove one another, typically performed to aggressive rock music
The crowd formed a mosh pit near the stage.

Neonatal Intensive Care Unit
The premature baby spent several weeks in the NICU.

an event or period lasting all night; a person who stays up all night
They pulled an all-nighter to finish the project.

A person with an obsessive interest in anime and manga
He's a huge otaku, with a room full of manga and anime figures.

An animal bred from parents of the same breed or variety
The dog was a purebred Labrador.

A person who pays local taxes
The council is accountable to the ratepayers for how their money is spent.

a limit beyond which something becomes unsafe or undesirable
The engine's tachometer showed it was approaching the redline.

a substance used for refrigeration
The air conditioner needs more refrigerant to cool effectively.

the bottom of the sea
Scientists discovered new species on the seafloor.

the act of walking around while asleep
Sleepwalking can be a symptom of certain sleep disorders.

a knot that can be undone by pulling one end
He tied a slipknot in the rope.

a person or vehicle that moves at high speed
The police chased the speedster down the highway.

a long or elaborate speech or story, typically one used to persuade someone
The salesman gave his usual spiel about the product's benefits.

a medical instrument for listening to the action of the heart or breathing
The doctor used a stethoscope to listen to her heart.

a balance achieved between two desirable but incompatible features; a compromise
There's always a tradeoff between quality and price.

a fleshy, usually rounded, underground storage organ of a plant
Potatoes are a type of tuber.

a fabric woven with a diagonal parallel rib pattern
Denim is a type of twill fabric.

an increase or improvement
The economy is showing an upswing.

the practice of not eating or using animal products
Veganism is growing in popularity.

a sleeveless upper-body garment worn over a shirt
He wore a smart three-piece suit with a waistcoat.

a calculating tool
Children in some schools still learn to use an abacus.

a plant whose seeds are used for flavoring
The candy had a distinct flavor of anise.

a youthful or innocent-looking face; a person with such a face
Despite his age, he still had a babyface.

A type of fuel made from plants or animal fats.
Many vehicles can run on biodiesel, which is a more environmentally friendly fuel.

A slight mistake or a small, quick movement.
The outfielder made a bobble, allowing the runner to advance to third base.

A type of sled used for racing down an ice track.
The bobsleigh team trained hard for the Winter Olympics.

A barrier built out into the sea to protect a harbor or coast from waves.
The breakwater protected the small fishing boats from the strong ocean currents.

An instrument used for measuring internal or external dimensions.
The engineer used a caliper to measure the precise diameter of the pipe.

An extremely easy task; a strap for a saddle.
Winning the game was a cinch for our team.

A type of high-altitude cloud, typically thin and wispy.
The sky was filled with delicate cirrus clouds, indicating fair weather.

Severe pain in the abdomen caused by gas or obstruction in the intestines.
The baby cried for hours due to severe colic.

a freshwater crustacean resembling a small lobster
We caught some crawfish in the stream.

small pieces of dead skin in a person's hair
He used a special shampoo to control his dandruff.

a person who does something
He's more of a doer than a talker.

a weight class in boxing or wrestling; something very light
He competed in the featherweight division.

a form of vitamin B
Folate is important for cell growth.

a member of a nomadic people; a person who lives a nomadic life
The old gipsy woman told fortunes.

a tiny, quick flash of light
There was a glint of mischief in his eyes.

permission to proceed with a project
The project received the greenlight from the board.

a fan, especially of a musical group, who follows them on tour
She was a dedicated groupie, following the band everywhere.

severity or cruelty; roughness
The harshness of the winter weather was unexpected.

the state or quality of being hot
The hotness of the chili pepper made my eyes water.

the state of not being responsible or accountable
His irresponsibility led to the project's failure.

a cord or strap worn around the neck or wrist to hold an item
He wore his ID card on a lanyard around his neck.

a disappointment
The movie was a real letdown after all the hype.

long, easy strides
The deer moved through the forest with graceful lopes.
